ios.desc:
Ask yourself these questions:
1.	Do you often run into an old acquaintance but can’t remember their name?
2.	Do you find it difficult to remember the birthdays of people who matter to you?
3.	Have you ever wondered how politicians and “super-networkers” maintain so many connections?
The reason is simple: building and maintaining a rich network of close relationships doesn’t happen by accident—it takes intention. It requires remembering the details about the people you meet, taking notes, and occasionally reaching out to prevent relationships from fading.
Enter your personal CRM.
Koligo is a powerful yet simple contacts manager designed to help you stay meaningfully connected. Whether it’s old friends, colleagues, or family, Koligo makes it easy to manage your relationships with thoughtful features like:
•	Reconnection Reminders – Never lose touch again. Get gentle nudges to reach out based on your custom intervals.
•	Birthday Reminders – Celebrate important days right on time.
•	Contacts Categorization – Organize your network by tags, groups, or relationship type for quick access and better clarity.
•	Notes Journal – Keep track of key details and conversations so you’re always in the loop when reconnecting.
Koligo is your personal relationship assistant—built for intentional networking and genuine connection.
